Describe index-based command behaviour precisely, simplify the add
syntax summary, and name the commands that operate on archived

Add blank lines between descriptions, parameters, rules, and
examples so every command usage message follows the same layout.
Fix result panel and compact layout issues
Fix issues from the Developer Guide audit
Declare notable uses of AI in the Developer Guide

commitResults.messageTitle: Show three lines of command feedback
commitResults.messageBody:
The result panel is 44 pixels high and shows only one line, so a
two-line message such as a rejected lesson time is cut off.

Raise the panel to 68 pixels and remove the extra top padding, so
that most messages fit without scrolling. Long usage messages still
scroll.

Fixes #179

commitResults.messageTitle: Lighten sidebar hover and command selection
commitResults.messageBody:
Sidebar buttons inherit the dark blue hover colour of ordinary
buttons, which makes their labels hard to read. The command box also
selects text in the same strong blue.

Give sidebar buttons light hover colours, and use light blue for the
selected text and focus border of the command box.

commitResults.messageTitle: Keep student details readable in small windows
commitResults.messageBody:
Tags share a row with the student name, so several tags or one long
tag can hide the name. At the minimum window size, sidebar labels are
cut off, phone numbers split across lines, and the empty list message
is truncated. The default window size may also exceed a small screen.

Move tags to a wrapping row below the name, and limit the width of
long tags. Tighten the sidebar, index, and details spacing, wrap the
empty list message, and keep the opening size within the primary
screen. These changes support the layout checks in #119.

The guides show tags beside the student name and do not explain how
long values are displayed. The User Guide also says that `edit` keeps
Active Students highlighted, but `edit` keeps the current view.

Describe the result panel and card behaviour, correct the sidebar
description, add a manual test for the minimum window size, and
replace the main window screenshot.

commitResults.messageTitle: Reduce the result panel to two lines
commitResults.messageBody:
A 68-pixel result panel leaves a large gap under one-line messages
such as the `list` confirmation, and it shortens the student list.

Set the panel to 52 pixels. Most messages fit at the default window
size, and longer messages scroll. Update the guides, the manual test,
and the main window screenshot to match.

commitResults.messageTitle: Ignore line endings in theme layout tests
commitResults.messageBody:
The new layout tests search for multi-line text in the stylesheet, so
they fail on Windows, where Git checks files out with CRLF endings.

Normalize line endings when the tests read a resource, so that the
tests pass on every platform.

commitResults.messageTitle: Highlight Active Students after adding a student
commitResults.messageBody:
`add` shows all active students, but the sidebar keeps highlighting
the previous view, so Upcoming Lessons or Archived Students can stay
selected over the active list.

Select Active Students after a successful `add`. A rejected `add`
leaves the list unchanged, so its highlight stays the same.

Fixes #186

commitResults.messageTitle: Keep the restored window position on screen
commitResults.messageBody:
The saved window position is restored without checking that it is
still visible, so an edited preferences file or a disconnected
monitor can open the window off-screen.

Keep the restored position within the visible bounds of the screen
that holds it, or of the primary screen if no screen holds it. Use
that screen to limit the window size as well, so a window saved on a
larger external monitor keeps its size there.

The Developer Guide still describes edited flags, says that student
cards show every detail, and omits `schedule` from the commands that
share the tokenizer. Those descriptions no longer match the code.

Describe `FieldUpdate` and `PersonDetailsPanel`, correct UC02, and
update the manual-test expectations to match the current interface.

Fixes #193

The `archive` story is marked as unlikely although it is implemented,
`clear` and `help` have no use cases, and NFR 11 cannot be tested.

Raise the story priority, add the missing stories, use cases, and
extensions, define common terms in the glossary, and give NFR 11
measurable limits.

Fixes #190

commitResults.messageTitle: Cover all features in manual testing
commitResults.messageBody:
The manual testing instructions have no section for `find` and
`filter`, and they omit `clear`, `help`, the sidebar, the details
panel, legacy data files, and values that resemble prefixes.

Add tests for those features so that a tester can exercise every
user-testable enhancement.

Fixes #189

The guide lacks a section separator, its launch step assumes one JAR
file name, and `docs` still holds AB3 diagrams that no page references.

Add the separator, make the launch step work for any JAR file name,
and remove the unreferenced diagrams.

Fixes #192

commitResults.messageTitle: Update the Model and parser class diagrams
commitResults.messageBody:
The Model diagram omits the guardian, tutoring, learning, lesson, and
result-view types, and the parser diagram shows a tokenizer that the
parsers no longer use.

Add the missing types and multiplicities, show
`CommandArgumentTokenizer`, and regenerate both images.

Fixes #188
Separate sections in long command usage messages

commitResults.messageTitle: Acknowledge the sidebar and application icons
commitResults.messageBody:
The Developer Guide does not credit the sidebar icons, which are
reused from Material Design Icons, or say that the application icon
was generated using AI.

Add both to the Acknowledgements to follow the reuse policy.

commitResults.messageTitle: Widen the Material Design Icons acknowledgement
commitResults.messageBody:
Some details-panel icons match Material Design Icons, and two sidebar
icons are adapted rather than copied unchanged.

Credit both groups as reused or adapted.

NFR 11 promises to show any 40-character name, but a valid name of
40 wide characters is shortened at the default window size.

State the exact name and tag values tested at that size, so that the
requirement is measurable and true.
Clarify Help command wording

The User Guide has an example that fails when followed in order and a
known issue that #182 fixed. It omits that `add` shows the active
list and that command words are case-sensitive. The Developer Guide
and setup guide have similar small gaps.

Correct those details so that the guides match the product.

Part of #184

The application still reports v1.5, so the log would not match the
v1.6 release.

Report v1.6.

The query diagram still shows `edit` resetting the view. The schedule
and edit diagrams keep activation bars after their calls return, and
the delete diagram passes an index to `deletePerson`. The upcoming
diagram shows a static call as a self-invocation.

Match the diagrams to the code and to the course notation, and
regenerate their images.

Part of #184

commitResults.messageTitle: Declare notable uses of AI in the Developer Guide
commitResults.messageBody:
The course policy on reuse requires widespread AI use to be declared
in the Developer Guide acknowledgements. The guide credits other
reused work but does not mention AI tools.

List how the team used Codex and Claude Code, and state that the
team reviewed and tested AI-assisted work.
